items.title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill
